description.description: A satirical infographic titled 'DRAGON BALL FAMILY TREE' displaying character portraits connected by red lines. The first generation shows Bardock and Gine as parents of Goku. The chart then humorously suggests that Chi-Chi is the partner to every subsequent male, including her own son Gohan and grandson Goku Jr., leading to an illogical genealogy ending with Shallot.
